whatThisIs: GBLS (Greater Boston Legal Services) offers free legal services to low-income individuals in the Greater Boston area who cannot afford to hire private legal services. It offers services when there is a demonstrated need for legal assistance with housing, unsafe job conditions, immigration, or protection from domestic violence.
whoItHelps: Individuals who need assistance with immigration law.
Individuals who need assistance with family law.
Individuals who need assistance with housing disputes, such as unsafe housing or rent disputes.
Individuals who need assistance with workers' rights.
whatToKnow: If you would prefer assistance over the phone to check eligibility, GBLS intake counselors speak Cantonese, English, Haitian Creole, Mandarin, Portuguese, and Spanish. GBLS also has interpreters for other languages.
GBLS has a limited service area. Check its eligibility website to see whether your town falls within that area.
name: Free Civil Legal Help
